title: Lightly Aerated Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: Tangy and aerated Malaysian dish featuring English mustard, this satay is a show-off recipe that is onion and garlic free, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.
Thread 2-3 chicken strips onto each bamboo skewer.
In a large bowl, whisk together English mustard, coconut milk, lime juice, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken skewers to the bowl and marinate for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken skewers from the marinade and grill for 5-7 minutes per side.
Brush the chicken skewers with vegetable oil during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the satay hot with your favorite sides.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
